All three new widgets render with correct data, are pixel-clean, and existing dashboard widgets are NOT regressed. Login as kishan (Admin) and bsingh (Papa) both show all 3 new widgets. No new backend was added — frontend-only iteration.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (Pre-existing, not from Phase 2 files, but forex-widget & trips-vault-info also use shadow-family via Platform.select for native.)

Console error 'Invalid style property of "background". Please use long-form properties.' — the Platform.select({ web: { background: 'linear-gradient(...)' } }) shorthand is invalid on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/forex-widget.tsx:217. Use backgroundImage/backgroundColor long-form instead.

Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard-charts.tsx:374 and /app/frontend/src/components/trips-vault-info.tsx:236 (pre-existing pattern in codebase).

action_items: Optional cosmetic cleanup: replace Platform.select web `background: 'linear-gradient(...)'` shorthand with `backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(...)'` in forex-widget.tsx and trips-vault-info.tsx to silence the 'Invalid style property of background' console error (does not affect rendering).

Optional: migrate remaining `shadow*` and `textShadow*` shorthand styles to the new RN long-form (`boxShadow` / `textShadow`) — appears across several older components too, safe to leave for a dedicated cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: forex.ts uses in-memory Map cache — will reset on every full page reload, which is fine for a web preview but if the dashboard is remounted the fetch will re-fire. Consider AsyncStorage/expo-secure-store if you want cross-session caching.

forex-widget: `inverse` path negates change_pct correctly (1/x is monotonically inverse), and inverts min/max — verified visually with INR→THB card showing -0.66% (opposite sign of USD→THB drift over 30d).

trips-vault-info: `active` filter is `diff <= 3` (past 3 days through infinite future) with `.slice(0, 6)` — safe. Est. Value falls back gracefully through gold_sale_inr → currency_amount*purchase_rate_inr → gold_cost_inr.

dashboard-charts RevenueBar: sums `abs(debit)+abs(credit)+abs(amount)` — this double-counts because most entries have either debit XOR credit (not both). The magnitude proxy is fine as-is, but the label 'REVENUE (6M)' may be misleading; consider labelling as 'ACTIVITY (6M)' or using only credit sums for accuracy.
arcPath draws `M cx cy L start L … Z` which puts an extra point at the center — correct for pie wedges but the `sweep === TAU` full-circle short-circuit is correctly handled with Circle.
